summary: Thread close, reopen and rename show neutral feedback only after the server confirms success

compatibility.detail: Confirmed close names the thread and the host-appropriate reopen key; reopen and rename name the result. Refusals remain warnings. Long notices use the footer's ellipsis.

manual.detail: Close, reopen and rename a writable thread. Observe Info feedback only on the accepted receipt; a rejected action shows Warn instead. Inbox close uses z reopens; typing panes use alt+z reopens.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes beyond the requested existing mutations.
